cause: New data flows, outside companies and stored items ship without anyone updating the privacy notice or terms, because there is no list of where data goes that is checked against the notice.
guard: Keep one data-flow register (every outside company, stored item and keep-for time); a check fails when code sends data to a host or keeps a table not in the register, and every register change needs a notice update in both languages plus an in-app notice-changed prompt.

cause: A typed mobile number is trusted as a person's identity with no proof it is theirs and no way to change it, so recycled numbers, strangers and look-alike names can take over sign-in, messages and enquiries.
guard: Every place that uses a mobile number as identity requires a proven number (WhatsApp check) and offers a change-number step, with a test that a number in two gyms or re-assigned cannot open the other.

cause: Rate limits and AI caps are one shared bucket per day, gym or whole product with no per-caller limit (and the real caller address is lost behind our server), and some endpoints answer anyone, so one outsider can use them up or get free AI.
guard: Every public endpoint must have a per-caller limit before any shared ceiling, read the real caller address, and require a gym or member key for AI answers; a check lists every endpoint with its limits and an alert on spikes.

cause: A gym's plan, trial, branch and paid-until state is changed by many separate HQ and payment actions, each with its own logic, so hand plans, trials, branches, founding places and upgrades contradict each other and the promises.
guard: Route every change to a gym's plan through one server function that enforces the plan rules (trial length, branch price, founding count, planned switches, paid-until in the future), with a table-driven test of every HQ action.

cause: There is no single list of every table and file that holds a person's or gym's data, so member erase, member delete and gym delete each forget some copies (photos, measurements, AI history, enquiries, shop copy, second database) or delete records that must stay.
guard: One server-side data inventory that every erase and delete path walks, with a test that seeds one row in every personal-data table and storage folder and asserts erase leaves none (and tax records stay).

cause: Whether a member owns MettleUp Plus, its plan type, free month and staff unlock live only on the phone, with no server record checked with Google Play, so purchases are missed, double-charged, kept after they end or guessed.
guard: Before Plus goes live, verify every purchase and staff unlock on the server with Google Play and keep the entitlement there; the phone only reads it, with a test for pending, refunded, cancelled and reinstall cases.

cause: Privacy sentences on screens and websites ('never sent', 'not kept', 'we never message you', 'only on this phone') are typed once by hand and not worked out from the real sharing switches and stored copies.
guard: Build every privacy sentence from the sharing switches and the data-flow register, with a test per sentence that flips each switch and checks the words still hold.

cause: Keep-for limits promised in the notice are left to chance: some deletes only run when someone opens a screen and many tables have no clean-up at all, because no nightly job owns every stated limit.
guard: One nightly clean-up job driven by a keep-for table that lists every personal-data table with its limit; a test fails when a table holding names, numbers or photos has no row in it.

cause: Whether a payment link or fee ask is open, paid online, expired, cancelled or failed is not one record every screen reads, so desk, shop, enquiry and member screens guess and show pay buttons, old UPI IDs or 'not paid' for money already taken.
guard: Keep one payment-request status on the server that every desk and member screen reads (and re-reads on return), with a test for each status across the enquiry, shop, receipt and member screens.

cause: The money records have no refunded or reversed state, so cancelling an online-paid receipt or order, a double payment, an over-payment or a wrongly confirmed payment leaves no way to record that money went back.
guard: Add a refunded/reversed state to the payments ledger; every cancel or void path must check for an online payment and set it, guarded by a test per cancel path.

cause: Member and gym status changes (leave, return, lapse, archive, pause, gym leaving) are not one state machine, so each feature handles them its own way and members stay archived, duplicate, lose marks or stay on machines and web pages.
guard: One member and gym lifecycle state machine on the server that every feature subscribes to, plus a cross-role test that walks leave, return, lapse and pause through every feature.

cause: Website, store listing and join-page claims about product behaviour are written by hand and not re-checked when a feature changes or is retired (Drive backup, messages, renew, reminders, switching offer).
guard: A claims register: each public claim links to the feature switch or test it depends on, and a check fails when that feature changes without the claim being re-approved.

cause: Whether a payment is test or live is not carried with each payment, so test payments create real plans, receipts, member alerts and 'Paid' lines, and help and HQ treat test as real.
guard: Store test-or-live on every payment and request and pass it to every plan, receipt, alert and screen; a test makes one test-mode payment and checks no surface treats it as real.

cause: AI credit rules (what costs a credit, starter credits, monthly free numbers, pack prices) are typed by hand into the website, help, HQ and credits sheet instead of read from one price table.
guard: One credit-rules table that the server, credits sheet, HQ and website copy read from, with a test that every credit sentence matches it.

cause: The server accepts role-limited actions and values (pass member, every-branch, door dates, offline flag, back-dated check-ins, option prices) exactly as the admin app sends them, so desk limits exist only on screen.
guard: Check role and value for every write on the server (desk vs owner, dates from saved plans, prices from the catalogue), with a test that calls each write with a desk key and odd values.

cause: Words about which watch and phone apps exist (watch on public Play, Apple Watch, iPhone coming soon, which watches work) are written by hand and not tied to what is really released.
guard: One availability list (per platform: test track, public, paused) that the websites, check-in page and phone watch offer read from.

cause: Restore, replace and undo on the phone act only on the phone's workouts, unaware of the background cloud copy and of other record types, so undone data returns and counts are wrong.
guard: Restore and undo go through one step that pauses or updates the cloud copy and counts every record type, with a test for a signed-in member.

cause: Cash taken on a desk without internet that the server later refuses (or never receives) has no proper state, so it vanishes from dues and counts, leaves receipt gaps or sits on a removed device unseen.
guard: Give refused or unsent offline money its own visible state on the server and the member page, and warn before removing a device or going read-only while any is held.

cause: The data agreement promises every look at a gym's records is recorded and shown, but direct database reads, master-key reads and reads past a cap are not recorded and the record keeps raw query text.
guard: Every read path to gym data writes to one access log (no cap, query values blanked) that the access card reads, with a test per read path.

cause: Consent, opt-outs and age are not recorded: joining keeps no notice or 18+ record, age is a fixed number, minors can be added, default sharing has no lawful basis and members cannot opt out of offers.
guard: Store consent with version, date and birth year at every join and sharing switch, plus a no-offers mark, with a test that each outward send checks it.

cause: Hiding names and numbers before sending to the AI is done separately in each call, so rewrites and some import columns send real details, and public lines claim the AI sees columns only.
guard: One send-to-AI step that masks personal data for every call, with a test that no phone, email or name reaches any AI request, and public claims worded from it.

cause: Facts are read from free-text names (plan names, friend names, exercise names) instead of fixed ids.
guard: Match by id from fixed lists; a lint flags name-word matching for business rules.

cause: Copies of gym data kept on staff browsers and phones (set-aside copy, outbox, offline member list) have no end date and are not wiped when the person is removed or signs out.
guard: Every on-device copy carries a last-server-contact date and owner; the app refuses to open it after a set age, removal or sign-out, and deletes it once uploaded.

cause: Excel import does not record what it changed in existing members (prices, filled details, app links, measurements), so undo removes or keeps the wrong things.
guard: Import keeps a full before-and-after record per member it touches and undo replays it, with a test on a gym that already has members.

cause: Reminders and birthday wishes are assumed to reach the member's phone, with no check of Android's limits or whether the phone shows them.
guard: Check delivery conditions on the phone (unused-app pause, phone-side setting) and word panel promises from what the phone reports.

cause: The photo backup switch was moved out of reach, so members cannot turn it off.
guard: Every on switch for sharing or backup must have a reachable off switch, checked by a settings test.

cause: Backlog, feature list and planning notes are kept by hand and never re-derived from code and switches, so they say things are live, built, switched off or private when they are not.
guard: Derive the Live and Hidden rows of the feature list from the feature switches and code, and require every 'live' row to cite a test or switch.

cause: Receipts, WhatsApp messages and hints each work out their own amounts, dates and plan names instead of reading one shared calculation, so they disagree with each other and the real plan.
guard: One money summary function per member (due, plan, end date, saving, joining fee) used by every receipt and message template, with a test that compares every template's figures to it.

cause: Each report, tile and summary defines its own count (visits vs members, archived included, fee vs total, GST, partial weeks, cancel time), so the same number differs between screens.
guard: One shared definition per metric used by every report, HQ tile and AI summary, with a test that compares the same metric across screens.

cause: There is no rule that every gym-scoped call gets a test proving another gym or member is refused, and the read-everything test checks empty tables.
guard: A generated test that calls every gym-scoped call and table with a second gym's and member's key against seeded rows and expects refusal.

cause: Outside icons, pictures, sounds, code packages and Hevy pages are used without a register of where they came from and what their licence asks, so credits and notices are missing.
guard: One rights register built from the dependency list plus a hand list of assets, and a build step that fails when a shipped asset or package is missing from it or from the Credits page.

cause: Money and weights are rounded in many places with different rules instead of one formatter, so paise vanish and kilos and pounds drift between screens and the watch.
guard: One money formatter and one weight formatter (convert first, round once, two decimals, paise shown) used everywhere, with a lint that fails on ad-hoc rounding.

cause: The hidden AI coach can be switched back on without safety rules, a report button, an app-side delete confirm, a live number check or a privacy-notice update, because no switch-on checklist exists.
guard: A coach switch-on checklist test that fails while any of safety rules, report button, confirm-before-delete, live number check, outward-data marks and notice lines are missing.

cause: Saves have no request id, version check or single-step write, so double taps, dropped connections and two desks at once save twice or undo each other.
guard: Every money and plan write carries a request id or last-seen version checked by the server in one step, with a double-send test per write.

cause: Erase, demo load and photo delete on the phone wipe a hand-picked list of stores, so photo folders, settings, trial dates, backup copies and the watch copy remain, and failures are hidden.
guard: One phone data inventory that erase walks (including watch and backup copies) and reports each step, with a test that every store is empty after erase.

cause: Dates and ages of readings are shown as day-and-month, time-only or raw day counts with no year or day, and a page's open line never refreshes.
guard: One shared date formatter that adds the day or year when not today or this year and turns long gaps into months or years.

cause: Text typed by members, desk staff or outside files (names, batch names, exercise names, help messages) is pasted into AI prompts as trusted facts with no fence, so it can steer the AI.
guard: One shared prompt-builder that fences and trims every outside string and tells the AI it is data, with a test that a crafted name cannot change the output.

cause: Nothing checks the apps' libraries for known security holes, so flagged spreadsheet, navigation, sharing and watch libraries ship.
guard: Turn on dependency alerts and a release check that fails on known high-rated flaws in phone, watch and panel libraries.

cause: The iPhone app is built on Android-only assumptions (update path, payment, Apple sign-in, notifications, iCloud backup, permission reasons) with no iPhone launch checklist.
guard: An iPhone launch checklist test that fails while any Android-only path lacks an iPhone version.

cause: MettleUp Plus is built but its launch rules (renewal and cancel words, refund rule, who counts as staff, gym cover versus free month) were never decided and written down.
guard: A Plus switch-on checklist (renewal line, cancel link, refund page, staff definition, gym-cover rule) that must be ticked before the Plus switch can be turned on.

cause: How many AI credits a task costs and when they come back is decided by the app or web caller, not by the server's ledger, so credits can be skipped, under-counted, charged for held-back answers or lost.
guard: The server works out every credit charge from the saved task and gives credits back itself (signed, retried), with a test for charge, hold-back and failed-task paths.

cause: Sign-ins and keys (panel, device, HQ, shop key, phone session) have no expiry and cannot be ended from the server, and the phone session sits in backed-up storage.
guard: Every session and key carries a server-side version and last-seen date; the server refuses idle or revoked ones, with a test per sign-in type.

cause: Offers, rewards and leaderboards count activity the server never verified (fixed-code check-ins, back-dated or imported workouts, made-up kg, reused codes, taken-back check-ins).
guard: Rewards and boards count only server-verified activity and remember what each reward covered, with a test per reward that replays and back-dates.

cause: Google Play rules (target version, unused permissions, Android 15 bars, outside update path, trader status) are not checked before release.
guard: A store-policy release gate that checks target version, permissions, update path and open Play Console tasks before any upload.

cause: Old What's new and update notes are never retired or re-checked, so they name old pages, describe things backwards and contradict each other.
guard: Release notes older than the last few versions are hidden or frozen with a note, and a check flags page names in notes that no longer exist.

cause: When a feature is switched off, retired or renamed, its code paths, buttons and stored names stay behind with no gate.
guard: A retirement checklist that searches for the feature's screens, tables, buttons and old names and either gates or removes each one.

cause: Plus limits are checked separately in each screen and entry point, so restore and chart ranges slip past and a mid-workout change is not passed on to the workout or watch.
guard: One shared Plus-limit check used by every gated entry point and observed live, with a test listing every gated feature and its entry points.

cause: The entry-machine link was built before a trust design: machines are identified by serial alone, punches can carry any date, and the link would be unencrypted.
guard: An entry-machine launch checklist (gym-held pairing secret, bounded punch dates, encrypted link) that must pass before the machine service goes live.

cause: Logos, page photos, product photos and profile text go out to members with no rights or consent line and no report or hide step.
guard: Every upload or public text box gets the shared rights/consent line and a report-and-hide control, checked by a test over all upload boxes.

cause: Picture storage rules and upload tickets are not tied to one gym or to published pages, so tickets are reusable, drafts can be listed and another gym's logo can be used.
guard: Storage rules require gym match and published state, tickets are single-file and gym-bound, unreferenced files are deleted, with a second-gym storage test.

cause: Cloud build runs pull outside code by moving versions, paste typed inputs into commands, have unlimited access passes and print account details to public logs.
guard: A workflow lint in CI: pinned actions, read-only default permissions, inputs via env and quoted, and no secret fields printed.

cause: Help articles quote buttons and questions by hand and nothing checks them against the screens.
guard: A test that finds every quoted label in the help articles in the app code.

cause: Tests start from an empty database and a single fresh path, never from last version's data, re-runs, passing time or every payment company.
guard: CI loads a saved demo gym from the previous version, re-runs every change, walks time forward and covers every payment company.

cause: The gym Pro pack switch is off and, when on, is enforced only on new rows and on the device, so Starter gyms keep Pro pages and the website sells them as Pro-only today.
guard: Enforce the pack on the server for every create and update of Pro data, fail closed when the pack is unknown, and tie the website wording to the switch date.

cause: Things decided or called worth building (teen accounts, QR location check, class booking) sit in the backlog with no owner, date or parked decision.
guard: Every backlog decision row carries an owner and a decide-by date, and a weekly check lists rows past their date.

cause: Server change files say by hand whether they are live, and nobody updates them after they are applied.
guard: Generate the applied/not-applied line from the live list of applied changes, checked in CI.

cause: Date maths assumes an easy calendar: month-end starts lose days, festival lists end silently, and kept answers use the save day.
guard: Shared date helpers for plan ends and lists with tests for 29-31 starts, 29 Feb, and a test that fails before listed years run out.

cause: The phone-watch link rests on assumptions (one install signal, the newest row, a counter that only rises) that break in real use.
guard: A shared watch-link contract: several-signal install check, send exact set at Done, accept counter restarts, with tests for each.

cause: Payment words in messages, invites and posters are fixed text ('pay at the desk', 'or on UPI') and do not read the gym's online-pay switch or saved UPI ID.
guard: Build every pay instruction from the gym's pay settings (in-app pay switch, UPI ID), with a test that flips each setting and checks every template.

cause: The nightly backup is a full readable copy, including secrets and PIN fingerprints, with no separate key and no record of who looks at it.
guard: Backups exclude secrets by a deny-list, are locked with their own key, and every restore or download is logged.

cause: A gym's join code is the only thing needed to join its member app, yet it is shown on the public page and has no wrong-try limit.
guard: Give the public page its own join-form code and count wrong codes per caller, with a test for guessing and page-code use.

cause: Fixes are announced in What's new before they are proven on the phone that had the problem.
guard: A release rule: a What's new line about a device fix needs a recorded real-device test on that device.

cause: Some gym choices (set-up ticks, language) are kept in the browser, not with the gym on the server, so a new device or address loses them.
guard: Keep every gym-level choice on the server, with a check that no gym setting is written only to browser storage.

cause: Dragging an exercise in a live workout can drop it in the wrong place.
guard: A real-finger drag test on the owner's phone size.

cause: A watch update prompt hides after Back and leaves no lasting sign.
guard: Any dismissible update prompt leaves a lasting badge until done.

cause: The assistant history saves the AI's first suggestion instead of what the owner saved.
guard: Save the saved draft with the task, with a test that edits are what history shows.

cause: Adding a GST number quietly makes every price GST-inclusive without telling the owner.
guard: Any setting that changes how prices are read must say so on the setting and price boxes.

cause: Past pass visits read the member's current pass company instead of the one saved at the visit.
guard: Records store the settings in force when they were made, with a test that changing a setting leaves history unchanged.

cause: Notification channels and their words were set once and not updated as new kinds of pop-up were added to them.
guard: A list of pop-up kinds mapped to channels and words, with a test that every sent kind has its own matching channel.

cause: AI that writes offers or answers visitors is not told what it must not promise (body results, things the gym never wrote).
guard: Shared writing rules banning health, result and unwritten promises in every customer-facing AI prompt, plus a rule-breaking test before switch-on.

cause: Members can share the gym's own workout plans outside the gym with no gym check.
guard: Owner decides the rule; share buttons on gym content follow it.

cause: Save my history writes typed names into spreadsheet cells as-is, so a name starting with = runs as a formula.
guard: All spreadsheet exports go through one writer that escapes formula signs.
